newsitem.title: PERU: South Korea's Kim arrives in Peru to foster trade.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's Kim arrives in Peru to foster trade.

text.p: South Korea's President Kim Young-sam arrived in Peru on Thursday on the last stop of a tour of five Latin American nations.
Kim was met by President Alberto Fujimori at Lima's military airport.
His three-day visit is aimed at helping Korean businesses expand in one of Latin America's fastest growing economies.

Kim is accompanied by 42 businessmen, including executives from the Hyundai, Sunkyong, Samsung and Daewoo groups, who are interested in investing in Peru, particularly in the booming mining sector, Korean embassy officials said.
Asian governments are increasingly looking to promote private investment in Peru and Japan's Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto visited Peru last month.
Kim was set to meet with Peru's Korean growing immigrant population later on Thursday before signing accords on Friday to promote trade and investment between the two nations.
Kim's Latin American tour took him to Guatemala, Chile, Argentina and Brazil.
